extracted.intended_audience: Users of the GAP computer algebra system (mathematicians, computational algebra researchers, and GAP developers)
extracted.subtask_description: Reference documentation for GAP functions, operations, and properties dealing with rings, ideals, modules, and fields. Defines predicates, constructors, attributes and their expected behaviour, return values, and usage notes/examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoSidedIdealNC / IdealNC / LeftIdealNC / RightIdealNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct ideals (two-sided, left, right) analogous to TwoSidedIdeal/LeftIdeal/RightIdeal but without checking whether all entries of gens lie in R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Effects are the same as the checked versions, but these 'NC' versions skip membership checks of gens. Use when you know gens belong to R to save checks.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsTwoSidedIdeal / IsLeftIdeal / IsRightIdeal / IsTwoSidedIdealInParent / IsLeftIdealInParent / IsRightIdealInParent
rubrics_metrics.description: Predicates/properties to test whether a given I is a two-sided/left/right ideal in R or whether ideal-in-parent attributes are set for an ideal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IsTwoSidedIdeal(R,I) returns true/false; attributes like IsTwoSidedIdealInParent are stored once known, avoiding recomputation. Examples show usage with matrix algebras.

rubrics_metrics.name: TwoSidedIdealByGenerators / IdealByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the ring generated by elements of gens under addition, multiplication, and multiplication with elements of R from the left and right (i.e., the two-sided ideal generated by gens).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The parent ring R can be accessed via LeftActingRingOfIdeal or RightActingRingOfIdeal; gens via GeneratorsOfTwoSidedIdeal. Use to construct the smallest two-sided ideal containing gens.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftIdealByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the ring generated by gens under addition, multiplication, and multiplication with elements of R from the left (left ideal generated by gens).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access the acting ring via LeftActingRingOfIdeal and gens via GeneratorsOfLeftIdeal. Use when closure under left multiplication suffices.

rubrics_metrics.name: RightIdealByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the ring generated by gens under addition, multiplication, and multiplication with elements of R from the right (right ideal generated by gens).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Access the acting ring via RightActingRingOfIdeal and gens via GeneratorsOfRightIdeal. Use when closure under right multiplication suffices.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfTwoSidedIdeal / GeneratorsOfIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of generators for the two-sided ideal I with respect to the left and right acting rings stored in the ideal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators are with respect to the rings returned by LeftActingRingOfIdeal and RightActingRingOfIdeal. Example shows a matrix algebra ideal with One(A) as generator.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfLeftIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of generators for the left ideal I with respect to the left acting ring stored as LeftActingRingOfIdeal(I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to examine or reuse the generating set for left ideals.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfRightIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of generators for the right ideal I with respect to the right acting ring stored as RightActingRingOfIdeal(I).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to examine or reuse the generating set for right ideals.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftActingRingOfIdeal / RightActingRingOfIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the left (resp. right) acting ring of an ideal I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use these to find the ring whose action generated the ideal, helpful when interacting with generators or constructing related objects.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsLeftIdeal / AsRightIdeal / AsTwoSidedIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: If S is a subring of R and S is a left/right/two-sided ideal in R, return the corresponding Ideal object; otherwise return fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Convenient to coerce a subring known to be an ideal into GAP's ideal object; example shows constructing a two-sided ideal from a subalgebra inside a direct sum.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRingWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter stating that a ring-with-one is a ring that is also a magma-with-one (i.e., supports an identity element). Identity and zero need not be distinct (zero ring allowed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Important for finitely presented rings: factors of a ring-with-one remain ring-with-one. Use to identify rings that possess an identity element in GAP's sense.

rubrics_metrics.name: RingWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructor returning the smallest ring-with-one containing given elements (arguments r,s,... or a collection).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If elements are not in a common ring an error is raised. Example: RingWithOne([4,6]) returns Integers.

rubrics_metrics.name: RingWithOneByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the ring-with-one generated by the elements in a collection coll (closure under addition, multiplication, additive inverses, and identity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when constructing the minimal ring-with-one containing a set of elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfRingWithOne
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of elements whose closure under addition, multiplication, additive inverses and the identity generate the ring-with-one R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R need not be known to be a ring-with-one. Example: GeneratorsOfRingWithOne(RingWithOne([4,6])) returns [1].

rubrics_metrics.name: SubringWithOne / SubringWithOneNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the subring-with-one of parent R generated by gens. The NC variant skips checks that gens lie in R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: When using SubringWithOneNC be sure gens actually belong to R to avoid unpredictable results.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsIntegralRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Property: A ring-with-one R is integral if it is commutative, contains no nontrivial zero divisors, and its identity is distinct from zero.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use IsIntegralRing to test for integral domains; example showing Integers returns true.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsUniqueFactorizationRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Category indicating every nonzero element has a unique factorization into irreducibles, unique up to permutation and multiplication by units.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes a caveat: factorization need not exist in subrings; therefore subset-maintained methods can't be installed. Example: polynomial ring in one variable over Q is UFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLDistributive
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if a*(b+c) = (a*b)+(a*c) for all elements a,b,c in collection C (left distributivity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Test of left distributivity for the collection C.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRDistributive
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if (a+b)*c = (a*c)+(b*c) for all a,b,c in collection C (right distributivity).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Test of right distributivity for the collection C.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDistributive
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if the collection C is both left and right distributive (IsLDistributive and IsRDistributive).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: IsDistributive(Integers) returns true.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAnticommutative
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if a*b = - b*a holds for all elements a,b in ring R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to check anti-commutativity (e.g., Lie-like structures).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsZeroSquaredRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if a*a equals zero for all a in R (every element squares to zero).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Identifies rings of nil-square type.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsJacobianRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if the Jacobi identity holds in ring R: x*(y*z)+z*(x*y)+y*(z*x)=0 for all x,y,z in R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect rings satisfying the Jacobi identity; example shows a FullMatrixLieAlgebra over GF(5) returns true.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsUnit
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning true if r is a unit (has a multiplicative inverse) in ring R (or in default ring), false otherwise.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: May call Quotient internally; suitable for checking invertibility of elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Units
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning the group (or list) of units of ring R (the multiplicative group of invertible elements).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: Units(GaussianIntegers) returns [-1,1,-E(4),E(4)]; Units(GF(16)) returns a group of size 15.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsAssociated
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning true if two elements r and s are associated in R (i.e., there exists a unit u with r*u = s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If not associated returns false; can be called with explicit ring R or use default ring of elements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Associates
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the set of associates of r in ring R (elements differing from r by multiplication by a unit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: Associates(Integers,2) returns [-2,2]; in GaussianIntegers returns 4 associates.

rubrics_metrics.name: StandardAssociate
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning a distinguished representative among associates of r in R (ring-dependent convention, e.g., absolute value in Z).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to normalize factorizations and gcd/lcm outputs. Example: StandardAssociate(-x^2-x+1) returns x^2+x-1.

rubrics_metrics.name: StandardAssociateUnit
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning a unit u in R such that u*r equals the StandardAssociate(r).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps convert between an element and its standard associate; example shows unit -1 relating r to its standard associate.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsIrreducibleRingElement
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning true if r is irreducible in R: r is not a unit and has no nontrivial factorization r = s*t with neither s nor t a unit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each prime element is irreducible; example IsIrreducibleRingElement(Integers,2) returns true.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsPrime
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning true if r is prime in R: whenever r divides s*t then r divides s or r divides t.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note in some rings irreducible ≠ prime. Can be called with explicit ring or default ring of element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Factors
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the factorization of element r in ring R as a list of primes; the list contains standard associates (except possibly first) and is usually sorted by size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For units or zero, Factors(R,r) = [r]. Example: factoring polynomials over GF(2) vs polynomial ring over GF(4) show different factorizations.

rubrics_metrics.name: PadicValuation
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation to compute the p-adic valuation of ring element r (valuation exponent of prime p dividing r).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for p-adic divisibility information; signature PadicValuation(r,p).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsEuclideanRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: R is Euclidean if it is a non-trivial commutative ring with a Euclidean degree δ: for r,s (s≠0) there exists q with r-qs=0 or δ(r-qs)<δ(s).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: In GAP, Euclidean degree is built into the ring. Euclidean rings support gcd via Euclidean algorithm and imply unique factorization. Example: GaussianIntegers is Euclidean.

rubrics_metrics.name: EuclideanDegree
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation giving the Euclidean degree δ(r) of element r in a Euclidean ring R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean. Example: EuclideanDegree(GaussianIntegers,3) returns 9.

rubrics_metrics.name: EuclideanQuotient
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the Euclidean quotient q of r and m in Euclidean ring R (q such that r - q*m is remainder of smaller Euclidean degree or zero).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean or an error is signalled. Example: EuclideanQuotient(8,3) returns 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: EuclideanRemainder
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the Euclidean remainder of r modulo m in Euclidean ring R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean. Example: EuclideanRemainder(8,3) returns 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: QuotientRemainder
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning both Euclidean quotient and Euclidean remainder of r and m in Euclidean ring R as a pair.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean. Example: QuotientRemainder(GaussianIntegers,8,3) returns [3,-1].

rubrics_metrics.name: Gcd
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning the greatest common divisor of elements r1,r2,... in ring R (or default ring), returning the standard associate of the gcd.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines divisor and gcd formally; special cases with zero are specified: Gcd(r,z)=StandardAssociate(r), Gcd(z,z)=z. Example: Gcd(Integers,[10,15]) returns 5.

rubrics_metrics.name: GcdOp
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation to compute the gcd of two ring elements r and s in ring R (or default ring).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as the binary gcd operation underlying Gcd over multiple arguments.

rubrics_metrics.name: GcdRepresentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning a representation of the gcd g of elements r1,r2,... in Euclidean ring R as a list of coefficients s1,s2,... such that g = s1*r1 + s2*r2 + ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such representations may not exist in all rings, but do exist in Euclidean rings. Example: GcdRepresentation(a^2+1,a^3+1) returns appropriate coefficients.

rubrics_metrics.name: GcdRepresentationOp
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation to compute the representation of the gcd of two ring elements r and s in a Euclidean ring R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Binary version of GcdRepresentation; requires Euclidean ring.

rubrics_metrics.name: ShowGcd
rubrics_metrics.description: Function that computes gcd of two elements a and b in Euclidean ring while printing the Euclidean algorithm steps and the rearranged combination expressing the gcd as a linear combination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Educational/debugging utility showing steps and final representation. Example: ShowGcd(192,42) prints steps and returns 6.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lcm
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning the least common multiple of elements r1,r2,... in ring R (or default ring), returning the standard associate of the lcm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines lcm and special cases with zero analogous to gcd. Use for computing common multiples normalized by StandardAssociate.

rubrics_metrics.name: LcmOp
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation computing the lcm of two ring elements r and s in ring R (or default ring).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Default method uses lcm(m,n)=m*n/gcd(m,n).

rubrics_metrics.name: QuotientMod
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning a quotient q of r and s modulo m in Euclidean ring R such that q*s = r modulo m, with q either zero or having Euclidean degree smaller than m; returns fail if none exists.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean to use EuclideanRemainder. Example: QuotientMod(7,2,3) returns 2.

rubrics_metrics.name: PowerMod
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning r^e modulo m in Euclidean ring R. If e negative it attempts to invert r mod m first.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R must be Euclidean. If inverse doesn't exist for negative exponent an error is signalled. Reduces intermediate values modulo m for performance. Example: PowerMod(12,100000,7)=2.

rubrics_metrics.name: InterpolatedPolynomial
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the unique polynomial of degree < n in ring R that takes values y[i] at x[i] for lists x,y of equal length n and distinct x entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard polynomial interpolation; x entries must be distinct. Example given with Integers.

rubrics_metrics.name: RingGeneralMappingByImages
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct a general mapping from ring R to ring S by specifying gens in R and their images imgs in S and taking additive and multiplicative closure; the result may be multivalued if gens don't generate R or mapping is not well-defined.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to create possibly multi-valued mappings; if mapping does not define an additive/multiplicative mapping result may be multivalued (i.e., not a function).

rubrics_metrics.name: RingHomomorphismByImages
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the ring homomorphism from R to S defined by mapping a list gens of generators of R to imgs in S; returns fail if gens does not generate R or mapping is not a homomorphism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use when you can provide a generator-to-image specification that defines a valid homomorphism.

rubrics_metrics.name: RingHomomorphismByImagesNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-checking variant of RingHomomorphismByImages: methods may assume gens generate R and mapping defines a ring homomorphism; behaviour unpredictable if assumptions fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use for performance when you are certain the preconditions hold; otherwise use the checked version.

rubrics_metrics.name: NaturalHomomorphismByIdeal
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the natural projection homomorphism R -> R/I given ideal I, enabling pre-image computations from quotient back to R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard quotient map; use to lift elements from quotient to original ring or to take preimages.

rubrics_metrics.name: SmallRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning the n-th ring of order s from a library of small rings (up to isomorphism) for small orders (up to 15).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for testing and examples; e.g., SmallRing(8,37) returns a ring with 3 generators. Use ShowMultiplicationTable to inspect structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: NumberSmallRings
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning the number of nonisomorphic rings of order s stored in the small rings library.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: List([1..15],NumberSmallRings) shows counts for orders 1..15.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subrings
rubrics_metrics.description: For finite ring R, returns a list of all subrings of R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for exhaustive exploration of subring structures; example given for a SmallRing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ideals
rubrics_metrics.description: For finite ring R, returns a list of all ideals of R.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for enumerating ideals in small finite rings; example given for SmallRing(8,37).

rubrics_metrics.name: DirectSum / DirectSumOp
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct the direct sum of the given rings. DirectSum accepts an arbitrary positive number of arguments and delegates to DirectSumOp which takes a list of two rings plus an explanatory ring to assist method selection.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Strange syntax supports method selection for special cases. Example: DirectSum(SmallRing(5,1),SmallRing(5,1)) returns a ring with 2 generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: RingByStructureConstants
rubrics_metrics.description: Return a ring R whose additive group is described by moduli and whose multiplication is defined by structure constants table sctable; optional nameinfo can provide element names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to construct rings from algebraic data (structure constants), with optional naming of canonical generators.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLeftOperatorAdditiveGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: a domain D lies here if it is an additive group closed under scalar multiplication from the left and satisfies λ*(x+y)=λ*x+λ*y for scalars λ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to classify domains that support left scalar action and additive group axioms.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: M is a left module if it is an IsLeftOperatorAdditiveGroup and the scalars form a ring with (λ+µ)*x = λ*x+µ*x and λ*(µ*x) = (λ*µ)*x.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use IsLeftModule to detect left modules; example shows full row space over rationals is a left module.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfLeftOperatorAdditiveGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of elements that generate D as a left operator additive group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives generators for domains supporting left operator additive group structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of elements that generate M as a left module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: generators of FullRowSpace(Rationals,3) are the standard basis rows.

rubrics_metrics.name: AsLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation AsLeftModule(R,D) returns D viewed as a left module over R if D is an additive group closed under left multiplication by R; otherwise fail.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to coerce compatible additive groups into module objects. Example constructing a vector space over GF(2).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRightOperatorAdditiveGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: D is an additive group closed under scalar multiplication from the right and satisfies (x+y)*λ = x*λ + y*λ.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Right-sided analogue of IsLeftOperatorAdditiveGroup.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRightModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: M is a right module if it is a right operator additive group and scalars form a ring with x*(λ+µ)=x*λ + x*µ and (x*µ)*λ = x*(µ*λ).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use IsRightModule to detect right module structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfRightOperatorAdditiveGroup
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of elements that generate D as a right operator additive group.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Gives generators for domains supporting right operator additive group structure.

rubrics_metrics.name: GeneratorsOfRightModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning a list of elements that generate M as a right module.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Note: description in text has a minor typo (says 'left module'); intended for right modules.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftModuleByGenerators
rubrics_metrics.description: Return the left module over R generated by gens, optionally supplying a zero element.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example constructs a vector space over GF(2^4) with 3 generators; gens must be vectors supporting addition and left scalar action.

rubrics_metrics.name: LeftActingDomain
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute/operation: for an external left set D closed under left action by domain L, LeftActingDomain(D) returns L (the domain acting on D).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to inspect the scalar ring/field acting on a module or similar object.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submodule
rubrics_metrics.description: Function Submodule(M, gens[, 'basis']) returns the left submodule of parent module M generated by gens; with 'basis' argument gens are assumed a basis (no checks performed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If 'basis' provided, linear independence and membership are not checked — useful for ideals/submodules known to be a basis.

rubrics_metrics.name: SubmoduleNC
rubrics_metrics.description: Non-checking variant of Submodule: constructs the submodule from gens without checking that gens lie in M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use only when you know gens are elements of M for performance reasons.

rubrics_metrics.name: ClosureLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation returning the left module generated by left-module generators of M together with element m (i.e., closure of M with m adjoined).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to expand a module by adding an element. Example shows adding [1,1,1] to a 2-generator space yields a 3-generator space.

rubrics_metrics.name: TrivialSubmodule
rubrics_metrics.description: Function returning the zero submodule of M.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standard zero submodule constructor; example returns vector space of dimension 0.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFreeLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute/Category: a left module is free if it is isomorphic to a direct sum of copies of its left acting domain; free modules can have bases and their characteristic equals that of the left acting domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect free modules and to reason about bases and dimension.

rubrics_metrics.name: FreeLeftModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructor FreeLeftModule(R, gens[, zero][, 'basis']) returns free left module over R generated by gens; optional zero element and 'basis' flag to declare gens as basis without checks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Generators must be actual vectors (support addition and left scalar action). Not the same as abstract free-group like constructors; for infinite-dimensional use row spaces or polynomial rings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dimension (for free left modules)
rubrics_metrics.description: Attribute returning the dimension n of a free left module if it is isomorphic to direct sum of n copies of its left acting domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dimension is not marked invariant under all isomorphisms to allow UseIsomorphismRelation for modules over different domains. Example: Dimension returns 2 for a module isomorphic to R^2.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFiniteDimensional
rubrics_metrics.description: Property true if M is a free left module that is finite dimensional over its left acting domain.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use to determine finiteness of dimension; example returns true for a constructed 2-dimensional module.

rubrics_metrics.name: UseBasis
rubrics_metrics.description: Operation UseBasis(V, gens) declares the vectors in gens to form a basis of free left module V, storing derived information such as generators and dimension.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful when you can assert a basis and want GAP to cache generators and dimension for performance; example shows V now knows its dimension after UseBasis.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsRowModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Property indicating V is a free left module whose elements are row vectors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful to identify modules implemented as rows and to route methods to row-specific implementations.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsMatrixModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Property indicating V is a free left module whose elements are matrices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to identify modules whose elements are m-by-n matrices.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFullRowModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Property indicating M is a full row module R^n: a free left module over ring R where elements are row vectors of fixed length n and dimension equals n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Several functions delegate to full row modules (Iterator, Enumerator). Use FullRowModule to construct such modules.

rubrics_metrics.name: FullRowModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructor FullRowModule(R,n) returns the row module R^n.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: FullRowModule(Integers,5) returns (Integers^5).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsFullMatrixModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Property indicating M is a full matrix module R[m,n]: free left module with elements m-by-n matrices and dimension mn.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to detect and treat matrix modules appropriately.

rubrics_metrics.name: FullMatrixModule
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructor FullMatrixModule(R,m,n) returns the module R^[m,n] (m-by-n matrices over R as a module).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: FullMatrixModule(GaussianIntegers,3,6) returns (GaussianIntegers^[3,6]).

rubrics_metrics.name: IsDivisionRing
rubrics_metrics.description: Category: D is a division ring if it is a nontrivial associative algebra where every nonzero element has a multiplicative inverse; represented in GAP as a vector space over a division ring (possibly itself).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: LeftActingDomain attribute stores the field of coefficients. Note: being a division ring is not a property a ring can 'get' generally, due to representation as vector spaces.

rubrics_metrics.name: IsField
rubrics_metrics.description: Filter indicating D is a commutative division ring (i.e., a field).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: IsField(GaloisField(16)) and IsField(Rationals) return true. Use to detect field objects in GAP.

rubrics_metrics.name: Field (for several generators)
rubrics_metrics.description: Constructor Field(z,...) or Field([F,]list) returns the smallest field containing given elements (or field extension of given field F by listed elements). If no base field given, field constructed over itself.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to build fields generated by elements or to extend a base field by additional elements; designed to represent fields as vector spaces over subfields in GAP.
